name: djlib
description: Give it a YouTube or SoundCloud set link, or your Shazams: every track, which you own and which are missing, then the crate in set order, a rekordbox playlist and a checked USB stick. Needs the djlib engine; one line installs it and this plugin: curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/uneasymusings/dj-library-tool/main/install.sh | sh
